description: This file defines a class 'PadMMA100' that inherits from 'LearnedHeuristicRegression' and implements a heuristic prediction model for padding matrix multiplication (pad_mm) optimizations. It includes methods for checking preconditions, providing feedback, confidence threshold, retrieving the name, and predicting heuristic values based on various input contexts.
